card: Anchor encoding FF 1F vs FF 18 vs FF 1C: which ModRM byte opponents' writes/searches turn benign or fatal
analysis: With a 2-byte anchor at addr = 2 (mod 4) the ModRM sits at 3 (mod 4), exactly where MOVSW-family trails put A5, so the ModRM is always overwritten before FF in a descending trail: the ModRM choice cannot fix the MOVSW kill (FF A5 = jmp [di+d16]). MOVSB-family words replace both bytes, so ModRM is irrelevant there too.

Usable 2-byte encodings with a stable DS pointer: FF 1F [bx] and FF 18 [bx+si] (si=0 in the dwell). FF 1C [si] would need si = cell, but si is the template source for the movsb rebuild (conflict); FF 19/1D (di-based) need a per-generation pointer; FF 1A/1B are SS (arena) based. 3-byte forms move the anchor residue (family switch, already rejected).

So the ModRM only matters for byte-exact INT 87h signature searches. Static scan (scratch/A017/scan87.mjs, immscan.mjs): FF 1F CC CC searched by OpcodeHunter1, 2B2Team1/2 (2025) and PastRAMa, ATO1, JMP2HELL2, segment_fault1 (2024 live); FF 18 CC CC by EmoMutants2 (2025); CC CC FF 18 / CC CC FF 1C by segment_fault (2024 live and final). OpcodeHunter2/ATO2 merely use FF 18 as their own anchor.

candidates.label: c18
candidates.change: A and B: phoenix_init mov ax,01FFFh -> 018FFh, so the live anchor written by stosw is FF 18 (call far [bx+si], si=0) instead of FF 1F. One byte per warrior (A offset 0x68, B offset 0xB4: 1Fh -> 18h). Worker's own call far [bx] unchanged.
candidates.notes: Zero-size change; deterministic: only cohorts containing an anchor-signature searcher change. Gains vs FF1FCCCC searchers, losses vs FF18 searchers (EmoMutants, segment_fault final). Pooled CI includes 0; value scales with how often those teams appear.

candidates.label: c18x
candidates.change: c18 plus a guard byte: stosw; stosb; dec di; dec di (anchor reads FF 18 FF xx, matching neither FF 18 CC CC nor FF 1F CC CC); template copy 9 -> 10 words. +2 instructions per generation and at startup.
candidates.notes: Keeps the 2B2Team gain (+0.567) and removes the EmoMutants loss (+0.033), but the timing shift perturbs every cohort; strong -0.038 (W/L 1/6), lead_V6 -0.15. Rejected.

threatFindings.threat: INT 87h FF 1F CC CC searchers (OpcodeHunter, 2B2Team, PastRAMa 2024, ATO 2024 live, segment_fault 2024 live) hit rev0's live anchor
threatFindings.evidence: screen 12ks2: switching the anchor to FF 18 changes only searcher cohorts (2B2Team +0.600, OpcodeHunter +0.233); threat 1i4j6: OpcodeHunter +0.054 5/0, 2B2Team +0.267 5/0, PastRAMa24 +0.108 4/0; v9fo1: ATO24live +0.108 3/0, segfault24live +0.058

threatFindings.threat: FF 18 CC CC / CC CC FF 18 searchers (EmoMutants2, segment_fault 2024 final) would hit an FF 18 anchor
threatFindings.evidence: c18 loses: screen 12ks2 s2025-22 -0.167; threat 1i4j6 EmoMutants -0.050 1/4; v9fo1 segfaultF24 -0.051 1/5

threatFindings.threat: Any ModRM choice fixes the MOVSW-family anchor kill
threatFindings.evidence: analysis: ModRM byte at 3 (mod 4) is the byte A5 overwrites first; screen 12ks2 movsw cohorts unchanged (diff 0)

threatFindings.threat: Partial overwrites (FF byte only) behave differently for FF 1F vs FF 18 in the field
threatFindings.evidence: screen 12ks2: 46 of 50 cohorts bit-identical; the 4 changed cohorts all contain a signature searcher

threatFindings.threat: Guard byte after the anchor evades both signature families without other cost
threatFindings.evidence: screen snvrv: searcher cohorts behave as expected (2B2 +0.567, Emo +0.033) but the +2 turns/generation give strong -0.038 [-0.061,-0.015]; mechanism and timing effect confounded

recommendation: promote-candidate c18 (zero-byte, deterministic add-on; combine with zph / fix2steal / A003 C1). Expect its pooled effect to be small and tied to the frequency of FF 1F CC CC searchers (2025 OpcodeHunter, 2B2Team; 2024 PastRAMa, ATO, segment_fault live) versus FF 18 searchers (EmoMutants, segment_fault final). Do not promote c18x.
